_comment: LOCAL (NSAP-only) config: pilot-style, SCENE-MATCHED to the 12 EB-Navigation scenarios we evaluate. One scenario per exact EB-Nav target instance (matched by objectId, fallback = nearest same-category object to the EB-Nav position). Framing = a moderate 'pilot band' (~0.8-1.5m, where EB-Nav success is decided), NOT the far->close approach. Objects kept in DEFAULT state (no open/close), matching EB-Nav. Generate with: python rung2/gen_ebnav_dataset.py --config rung2/kitchen_ebnav.json --out SceneGraphBench/data/kitchen_ebnav
